newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny raising stainless sheet prices.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny raising stainless sheet prices.

text.p: Allegheny Teledyne Inc said Wednesday it plans to increase prices on stainless steel sheet products in May.
"We have begun notifying customers of a price increase," a company spokesman told Reuters. He declined comment on the size of the increase, citing "customer sensitivity" concerns.
He said the increase will take effect in May. It will be the second increase of the year. The company has a 5.0 percent price increase on sheet products scheduled to take effect tomorrow.
